definitions.explanation: Describes quick, alert movement or thinking. Can refer to physical agility, mental quickness, or prompt response to situations.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{機敏|きびん}に{反応|はんのう}した。
{機敏|きびん}な{対応|たいおう}のおかげで、{事故|じこ}を{未然|みぜん}に{防|ふせ}げた。
examples.english: Thanks to the quick response, we were able to prevent the accident.

notes:
ADJECTIVE TYPE: Na-adjective. Uses な before nouns: {機敏|きびん}な{対応|たいおう}.

ADVERBIAL FORM: {機敏|きびん}に (nimbly, quickly)

NUANCE: {機敏|きびん} emphasizes quick, alert responsiveness - both in physical movement and in reacting to situations. It suggests being sharp and ready to act.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {機敏|きびん}な{動|うご}き (nimble movement)
- {機敏|きびん}な{対応|たいおう} (quick response)
- {機敏|きびん}に{反応|はんのう}する (to react quickly)
- {機敏|きびん}に{動|うご}く (to move agilely)

RELATED WORDS:
- {俊敏|しゅんびん} (agile, swift - emphasizes speed)
- {敏捷|びんしょう} (nimble, agile)
- {素早|すばや}い (quick, swift - more common)
- {鈍重|どんじゅう} (dull, slow - opposite)
